Regression model to investigate correlation between PD status and Factor score (covariate SEX)

Factor Score ~ PD + Sex


```{r}
# PD ASSOCIATION TESTING SCRIPT
# MULTIPLE LINEAR REGRESSION: FACTOR SCORE ~ PD + SEX
# APPLIED SEPARATELY TO EACH MOFA MODEL
# ONE REGRESSION PER FACTOR, BH CORRECTION WITHIN EACH MODEL

.libPaths(c(
  "/cephfs/volumes/hpc_data_usr/k25093549/eabe5dc4-1fa9-4cdc-b2af-6a4d37d00142/R/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.5",
  .libPaths()
))

library(MOFA2)
library(ggplot2)

mofa_out_dir <- "/scratch/prj/bcn_marzi_lab/analysis_cutandtag_pd_sc/student_data_package/jd_analysis_sc/saved_objects/new_sc_mofa_clean_14042026"
pd_out_dir   <- file.path(mofa_out_dir, "pd_association")
dir.create(pd_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# LOAD SAVED MOFA MODELS
mofa_opalin_vst  <- readRDS(file.path(mofa_out_dir, "mofa_opalin_vst_object.rds"))
mofa_plekhg1_vst <- readRDS(file.path(mofa_out_dir, "mofa_plekhg1_vst_object.rds"))
mofa_opc_vst     <- readRDS(file.path(mofa_out_dir, "mofa_opc_vst_object.rds"))
mofa_4view_vst   <- readRDS(file.path(mofa_out_dir, "mofa_4view_vst_object.rds"))

# SAMPLE METADATA
# REPLACE SEX VALUES WITH ACTUAL VALUES FROM YOUR COHORT
sample_meta_full <- data.frame(
  sample    = c("PD1222", "PD1231", "PD726",  "PD833",  "PD936",
                "PDC167", "PDC184", "PDC197", "PDC87"),
  condition = c("PD",      "PD",     "PD",     "PD",     "PD",
                "Control", "Control","Control","Control"),
  pd_binary = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  sex       = c("M", "F", "M", "M", "F",
                "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sample_meta_full <- sample_meta_full[sample_meta_full$sample %in% mofa_samples, ]

cat("Sample metadata loaded:", nrow(sample_meta_full), "samples\n")
print(sample_meta_full)

# REGRESSION FUNCTION
# RUNS ONE REGRESSION PER FACTOR FOR EACH GIVEN MOFA MODEL
# MODEL: FACTOR SCORE ~ PD STATUS + SEX

# ADD 95% CI TO REGRESSION RESULTS
run_pd_regression <- function(mofa_obj, model_name) {
  
  cat("\n--- Running regression for", model_name, "---\n")
  
  factors_df <- as.data.frame(get_factors(mofa_obj, as.data.frame = TRUE))
  
  factors_df <- merge(factors_df,
                      sample_meta_full,
                      by.x = "sample",
                      by.y = "sample")
  
  factors_df$sex <- factor(factors_df$sex)
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (f in unique(factors_df$factor)) {
    
    fdata <- factors_df[factors_df$factor == f, ]
    n     <- nrow(fdata)
    
    mod <- lm(value ~ pd_binary + sex, data = fdata)
    s   <- summary(mod)
    
    # EXTRACT 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
    ci <- confint(mod, "pd_binary", level = 0.95)
    
    pd_row <- s$coefficients["pd_binary", ]
    
    results[[f]] <- data.frame(
      factor    = f,
      model     = model_name,
      n         = n,
      estimate  = pd_row["Estimate"],
      std_error = pd_row["Std. Error"],
      ci_lower  = ci[1],
      ci_upper  = ci[2],
      t_value   = pd_row["t value"],
      p_value   = pd_row["Pr(>|t|)"],
      r_squared = s$r.squared
    )
  }
  
  results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)
  results_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(results_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  results_df <- results_df[order(results_df$p_value), ]
  
  write.csv(results_df,
            file.path(pd_out_dir,
                      paste0(model_name, "_pd_regression_results.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Results for", model_name, "(n =", unique(results_df$n), "):\n")
  print(results_df[, c("factor", "n", "estimate", "ci_lower", "ci_upper",
                        "p_value", "p_adj", "r_squared")])
  
  pdf(file.path(pd_out_dir,
                paste0(model_name, "_residual_diagnostics.pdf")))
  for (f in unique(factors_df$factor)) {
    fdata <- factors_df[factors_df$factor == f, ]
    mod   <- lm(value ~ pd_binary + sex, data = fdata)
    par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
    plot(mod, main = paste(model_name, f))
  }
  dev.off()
  
  return(results_df)
}

# UPDATE PLOT FUNCTION TO USE 95% CI
plot_regression_results <- function(results_df, model_name) {
  
  results_df$factor <- factor(
    results_df$factor,
    levels = paste0("Factor", sort(as.numeric(
      gsub("Factor", "", results_df$factor)
    )))
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(results_df,
              aes(x    = factor,
                  y    = estimate,
                  fill = p_adj < 0.05)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower,
                      ymax = ci_upper),
                  width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               linetype   = "dashed",
               colour     = "grey50") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE"  = "#E69F00",
                                 "FALSE" = "#0072B2"),
                      name   = "p.adj < 0.05",
                      labels = c("TRUE" = "Yes",
                                 "FALSE" = "No")) +
    labs(title    = paste(model_name, "- Factor association with PD"),
         subtitle = paste0("Multiple linear regression: Factor score ~ PD + Sex",
                           " | n = ", unique(results_df$n),
                           " | error bars = 95% CI"),
         x        = "Factor",
         y        = "PD coefficient (estimate, 95% CI)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(pd_out_dir,
              paste0(model_name, "_pd_regression_plot.pdf")),
    plot   = p,
    width  = 8,
    height = 5
  )
  
  return(p)
}

# RERUN ALL FOUR MODELS
res_opalin  <- run_pd_regression(mofa_opalin_vst,  "opalin")
res_plekhg1 <- run_pd_regression(mofa_plekhg1_vst, "plekhg1")
res_opc     <- run_pd_regression(mofa_opc_vst,     "opc")
res_4view   <- run_pd_regression(mofa_4view_vst,   "4view")

plot_regression_results(res_opalin,  "Opalin+")
plot_regression_results(res_plekhg1, "Plekhg1+")
plot_regression_results(res_opc,     "OPC")
plot_regression_results(res_4view,   "4-view")


cat("\nAll PD association analyses complete\n")
cat("Results saved to:", pd_out_dir, "\n")
```



```{r}
library(forestplot)


plot_forest <- function(results_df, model_name) {
  
  # ORDER FACTORS NUMERICALLY
  results_df <- results_df[order(as.numeric(gsub("Factor", "", results_df$factor))), ]
  
  # CREATE TABLE TEXT FOR LEFT SIDE OF PLOT
  tabletext <- cbind(
    c("Factor",      results_df$factor),
    c("Estimate",    round(results_df$estimate, 3)),
    c("95% CI",      paste0("[", round(results_df$ci_lower, 3),
                            ", ", round(results_df$ci_upper, 3), "]")),
    c("p.adj",       round(results_df$p_adj, 3))
  )
  
  # FOREST PLOT
  forestplot(
    labeltext = tabletext,
    mean      = c(NA, results_df$estimate),
    lower     = c(NA, results_df$ci_lower),
    upper     = c(NA, results_df$ci_upper),
    zero      = 0,
    col       = fpColors(box    = "#0072B2",
                         line   = "#0072B2",
                         zero   = "grey50"),
    xlab      = "PD coefficient (estimate, 95% CI)",
    title     = paste(model_name, "- Factor association with PD"),
    txt_gp    = fpTxtGp(label = gpar(cex = 0.9),
                        ticks = gpar(cex = 0.8),
                        xlab  = gpar(cex = 0.9),
                        title = gpar(cex = 1.0)),
    graph.pos = 3
  )
}

plot_forest(res_opalin,  "Opalin+")
plot_forest(res_plekhg1, "Plekhg1+")
plot_forest(res_opc,     "OPC")
plot_forest(res_4view,   "4-view")
```

Look at raw factor scores for each sample split by PD status to show differences in samples.
```{r}
plot_factor_boxplots <- function(mofa_obj, model_name) {
  
  # EXTRACT FACTOR SCORES
  factors_df <- as.data.frame(get_factors(mofa_obj, as.data.frame = TRUE))
  
  # MERGE WITH METADATA
  factors_df <- merge(factors_df,
                      sample_meta_full,
                      by.x = "sample",
                      by.y = "sample")
  
  # ORDER FACTORS NUMERICALLY
  factors_df$factor <- factor(
    factors_df$factor,
    levels = paste0("Factor", 1:7)
  )
  
  # ADD CONDITION COLUMN
  factors_df$condition <- ifelse(factors_df$pd_binary == 1, "PD", "Control")
  
  p <- ggplot(factors_df,
              aes(x = condition, y = value, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 2) +
    facet_wrap(~ factor, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#0072B2",
                                 "PD"      = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(title    = paste(model_name, "- Factor scores by PD status"),
         subtitle = "Each point represents one donor",
         x        = "",
         y        = "Factor score") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position  = "none",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(pd_out_dir,
              paste0(model_name, "_factor_boxplots.png")),
    plot   = p,
    width  = 14,
    height = 5,
    dpi    = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

plot_factor_boxplots(mofa_opalin_vst,  "opalin")
plot_factor_boxplots(mofa_plekhg1_vst, "plekhg1")
plot_factor_boxplots(mofa_opc_vst,     "opc")
plot_factor_boxplots(mofa_4view_vst,   "4view")
```

```{r}
mofa_out_dir <- "/scratch/prj/bcn_marzi_lab/analysis_cutandtag_pd_sc/student_data_package/jd_analysis_sc/saved_objects/new_sc_mofa_clean_14042026"

cat("Regression results loaded\n")

# =============================================
# FOREST PLOT FUNCTION
# =============================================

plot_forest <- function(results_df, model_name) {
  
  # ORDER FACTORS NUMERICALLY - HIGHEST FACTOR AT TOP
  results_df$factor <- factor(
    results_df$factor,
    levels = paste0("Factor", sort(as.numeric(
      gsub("Factor", "", results_df$factor)
    ), decreasing = TRUE))
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(results_df,
              aes(x      = estimate,
                  y      = factor,
                  colour = p_adj < 0.05)) +
    # POINT - EFFECT SIZE ESTIMATE
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    # HORIZONTAL ERROR BAR - 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVAL
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_lower,
                       xmax = ci_upper),
                   height = 0.2,
                   linewidth = 0.8) +
    # REFERENCE LINE AT ZERO - NO EFFECT
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               linetype   = "dashed",
               colour     = "grey50",
               linewidth  = 0.5) +
    # COLOURS - AMBER IF SIGNIFICANT, BLUE IF NOT
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("TRUE"  = "#E69F00",
                 "FALSE" = "#0072B2"),
      name   = "p.adj < 0.05",
      labels = c("TRUE" = "Yes", "FALSE" = "No")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste(model_name, "— Factor association with PD"),
      subtitle = paste0("Multiple linear regression: Factor score ~ PD + Sex",
                        "\nn = ", unique(results_df$n),
                        " | error bars = 95% CI"),
      x        = "PD coefficient (estimate, 95% CI)",
      y        = "Factor"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"),
      legend.position    = "right",
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 8)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(forest_dir, paste0(model_name, "_forest_plot.pdf")),
    plot   = p,
    width  = 7,
    height = 5,
    device = "pdf",
    bg     = "white"
  )
  
  cat("Saved forest plot:", model_name, "\n")
  return(p)
}

# GENERATE FOREST PLOTS FOR ALL FOUR MODELS


plot_forest(res_opalin,  "Opalin+")
plot_forest(res_plekhg1, "Plekhg1+")
plot_forest(res_opc,     "OPC")
plot_forest(res_4view,   "4-view")

cat("\nAll forest plots saved to:", forest_dir, "\n")
```
